onboarding.title: Set up your personal tracker
onboarding.no_sources: You can finish setup without connecting a data source.
tracker.values_prompt: Describe the time and values for {tracker}.
tracker.time_clarification: Please specify the date and exact time, for example 2026-10-22 at 14:00. A clock time alone does not establish the day. You can also use today, yesterday, or now.
agent.too_many_records: Specify no more than 20 records at a time.
agent.record_missing: The specified record was not found or was deleted. Check its ID.
agent.history_too_large: The history is too large to resolve this. Specify the date, time, and record.
agent.medication_update: Specify only the medication details you want to correct. Unknown details will remain blank.
agent.medication_repeat: Which medication did you take again?
agent.medication_details: Specify the medication details you know. Unknown name and dose will remain blank.
agent.medication_intakes: Specify every medication taken and the time of each dose so none are missed.
agent.medication_confirm: Confirm that you took the medication and specify when. The name and dose can remain unknown.
agent.selection_expired: The selection expired or the record changed. Open /history and select it again.
agent.question_episode: Which question and episode does your answer refer to?
agent.record_details: Please clarify the record's time and details.
agent.history_target: The history is too large to identify one correction. Specify the record ID from the API or MCP.
agent.selected_record: Clarify the selected record. For another action, send /cancel first.
agent.update_or_new: Is this a clarification of the saved record? For a new record, send /cancel first.
agent.close_episode: Which open episode ended, and when? For another record, send /cancel first.
agent.button_record: Clarify the record selected with the button. For another action, send /cancel first.
agent.timezone_mismatch: The time zone and UTC offset do not match. Clarify the local date, time, and time zone of the event.
agent.ambiguous_time: This time occurs twice when clocks change. Repeat each time with its UTC offset, for example 02:30+02:00 or 02:30+01:00.
agent.future_time: That time is in the future. Clarify the event date and time.
agent.diary_question_changed: The diary question has already been answered or changed. Repeat your message with the current details.
agent.context_unknown: Understood. I left the context unknown and won't repeat that question.
agent.episode_changed: The episode changed after the question. Clarify which migraine your answer refers to.
agent.episode_open: Understood, I saved your answer. The episode remains open; tell me when it ends.
agent.saved: Saved: {records}. You can correct a record with a regular message.
agent.budget: Analysis reached its data or computation limit. This does not mean there is no data. Narrow the time period or choose one metric.
agent.timeout: The answer could not be completed in time. Try again a little later. This does not mean there is no data.
agent.reply_context_missing: The selected reply's context is no longer available. Repeat the original question and analysis period.
agent.goals_changed: Personal goals changed. Repeat the question with the new settings.
agent.conversation_deleted: Conversation context was deleted. Repeat the question for a new analysis.
agent.data_changed: Data or access settings changed. Repeat the question.
agent.sleep_unavailable: Sleep time is unavailable with the selected access settings.
agent.sleep_unconfirmed: Garmin has not yet confirmed the recorded sleep time for wake date {day}. Please try again later.
agent.numbers_unverified: The numbers in the answer could not be verified. Clarify the time period and metric.
agent.answer_unverified: The answer could not be verified against saved data. Clarify the time period and metric.
agent.recalculated: Garmin data was recalculated during analysis. Repeat the question for an answer based on updated data.
agent.steps_exhausted: The analysis could not be completed within the step limit. Narrow the time period or question.
agent.oversized: The message is too long. Send it in several shorter messages. If you have sudden severe symptoms, do not wait for processing: call 112 or your local emergency service.
agent.replay: Garmin data is being recalculated after a processing update. Analysis is temporarily unavailable; this does not mean there is no data. Check /status later.
freshness.reason.recent_observations: enough data to assess the current state
freshness.reason.partial: recent readings exist, but there are gaps
freshness.reason.source_empty: the latest update contained no measurements
freshness.reason.parser_error: data was received but could not be processed
freshness.reason.not_synced: data has not been synced yet
freshness.summary_usable: available as the latest daily summary, not a real-time reading
freshness.summary_stale: the daily summary is outdated or its recency is unconfirmed
freshness.daily: daily update, not a real-time reading; {reason}
freshness.heading: Data recency at the time of your question:
freshness.checked_recently: Garmin was checked recently but returned no newer measurements.
